title: Flash8 re-theme Wave B: top chrome (MenuBar + EditBar + ToolsPanel) → light Halo
description: Convert packages/authoring-ui/src/MenuBar.tsx, EditBar.tsx, and ToolsPanel.tsx to the Flash 8 light theme via flash8Theme.ts per docs/30-flash8-ui-spec.md §3.1/§4.1. MenuBar: flat light-gray bar #ECECEC, black labels, dropdown white bg with blue (#316AC5 Luna / haloBlue) hover highlight, thin gray separators, gray disabled/shortcut text, ~19-20px bar height (spec §4.1). ToolsPanel: light system-gray ButtonFace bg, single-column ~22px square tool buttons with 16px monochrome dark glyphs, ACTIVE tool = depressed/sunken 3D bevel (use bevel helper), Colors section swatches, ~67px width (spec §3.1). EditBar: light chrome to match. Replace all dark hex with chrome.* tokens; mirror Shell.tsx pattern. Build+authoring-ui tests green (only ~3 task-1207 fixture failures acceptable). Screenshot if feasible. ACQUIRE the lock; commit incl task file; push rebase-retry. Scope: MenuBar.tsx + EditBar.tsx + ToolsPanel.tsx (+ read-only theme import).
